candidates.summary: Object.typ comes from the static type of the pointer the caller passes (declaredTypeName(v) reads tv.T), so one object yields several unequal Objects
candidates.failure_scenario: p := &T{X: 1} persisted; a realm dedupes by Object (map[reflect.Object]int, one vote or claim per object). The caller passes p, (*U)(p) with `type U T`, and (*struct{ X int })(p), all Go-legal conversions to the same object. Of returns the same ID and Address for all three but Type T / U / "", so a == b is false and the map holds 3 keys for one object. Type() reports the caller-chosen U, not the object's declared type. This contradicts reflect.gno:47-48, which says two Objects are equal if and only if they name the same object and are safe as a map key.
candidates.verify_by: cp tests/b1-catalog-object-type-varies.gno gnovm/tests/files/zrealm_reflect_b1_typevaries.gno && go test ./gnovm/pkg/gnolang -run 'TestFiles/zrealm_reflect_b1_typevaries' -v; the pinned Output passes with `a == b: false a == c: false` and `distinct keys for one object: 3`
candidates.evidence: PASS on head 58b269206 with Output: `same address: true true` / `same id: true true` / `types: gno.land/r/demo/reflectb1.T | gno.land/r/demo/reflectb1.U |` / `a == b: false a == c: false` / `distinct keys for one object: 3`

candidates.summary: objectInfo has a flat gas price (native_gas.go:157 SizeFlat, documented as not scaling with caller input), but declaredTypeName builds PkgPath+"."+Name on every call, so its cost grows with the length of the declared type's name
candidates.failure_scenario: A realm declares a type with a long name; gno has no identifier length cap, and MaxTxBytes is 1MB. It then calls reflect.Of in a loop. Each call pays 1200 flat gas plus allocGas(len) for the returned string through Go2GnoValue/alloc.NewString, while the Go-side concat does another allocation and copy of the same size that nothing bills.
candidates.verify_by: Benchmark X_objectInfo on one stamped object with a DeclaredType Name of 8 B, 1 KB, 64 KB and 1 MB (go test ./gnovm/stdlibs/chain/reflect -bench ... -benchtime 2000x). Compare each result with 1200 + allocGas(len) from alloc.go:206.
candidates.evidence: BenchmarkB1ObjectInfoTypeNameLen/8 3359 ns/op, /1024 3089 ns/op, /65536 96604 ns/op, /1048576 827394 ns/op (Ryzen 7840HS). Charged gas is about 11.8k at 64 KB and about 196.5k at 1 MB (allocGasTable[16]=10611, [20]=195342), so this machine runs 4-8x over the charge at extreme name lengths.
